response.summary: The SPDR NYSE Technology ETF (NYSEARCA:XNTK) offers something most tech ETFs don’t: equal-weighted exposure to the full technology spectrum. While mega-cap funds like QQQ concentrate 40% of assets in five stocks, XNTK spreads risk across 68.4% technology holdings with its largest position capped at 4.50%.
